content:
jordan: Heads-up — we need to lock the pricing bands and constraints for the Q2 inference offering. Launch on May 12 gate: pricing + billing UI + contract template. Can we get a quick read on tradeoffs?

sam: +1. My take — keep three price bands but make add-ons explicit. Customers keep asking for predictable unit cost + burst credits.

mike_sales: From AE calls: top requests = 1) lower entry price for SMB proof-of-concept, 2) predictable dedicated pricing for scale, 3) opt-in private deployment surcharge. Also many ask for flexible commit terms (monthly true-up).

eva_finance: We need guardrails: Dedicated pools should require a 3mo min commit unless elevated approval. Minimum ARR threshold for enterprise discounts: $120k/year. Overage rates must be >= list price x1.15.

nina_growth: Important metric: conversion curve vs monthly seat/commit. If entry band <$500/mo we see big signups but low conversion to committed revenue. Suggest a credit-based starter offering.

pricing-bot: Report generated: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/q2-bands (spreadsheet) — includes elasticity sims and revenue projections.

jordan: Proposal draft in the sheet:
```
Starter (shared) — $199/mo + metered tokens, 5k token bundle included
Scale (dedicated burst) — $2,500/mo base, 200k token bundle, optional burst credits
Enterprise (private) — custom pricing, min 12mo commit, SLA addon
Add-ons: extended retention, premium SLA, regional private deploy, custom quantization support
Contract constraints: monthly true-up allowed for Starter/Scale; Enterprise requires signed SOW + 30d notice for termination
```

sam: Launch criteria checklist (product): billing meter events + billing UI flows, docs + example contracts, churn/usage alert hooks. Also need default quotas and RBAC for multi-tenant console.

mike_sales: Can we make a flexible mid-tier for pilot-to-commit? E.g. 6mo ramp with pre-committed credits at a discount. Sales can sell faster with that option.

eva_finance: That ramp option ok if we enforce non-refundable portion (eg 50% upfront) and cap discount to 20%. Need clear accounting rules for recognition.

nina_growth: A/B test offer: Starter free credits -> $199/mo vs $299/mo to measure retention. Track LTV:CAC and time-to-commit.

jordan: Decision points for this week: (1) agree price bands and bundle sizes, (2) finalize minimum commit constraints for Dedicated/Enterprise, (3) accept ramp option terms, (4) product checklist signoff. Please reply with ✅ or raise objections.

mike_sales: ✅ for bands; request: include explicit language about burst fallbacks to hosted variants in SOW.

eva_finance: ✅ to bands with the 3mo min for Dedicated, Enterprise min ARR stays. Need legal to review SOW templates.

sam: ✅ on bands and product checklist. Will create PR for billing events.

nina_growth: ✅ and will queue the A/B test.

jordan: Great — I'll update the spreadsheet and ping legal + solutions for SOW language. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
